platform.audit-event.description: Records a security- or governance-relevant event for later review. Producers MUST redact secrets before emitting.

platform.readiness.description: Service health and readiness report. Status values are bounded and forward-compatible.

platform.gate-result.description: Outcome of a release Gate evaluation. The result value controls whether a deploy may proceed. Major 1 adds `review_required` (a human decision is still open) and `unbound` (a required check was asserted and no command was ever bound to it, so nothing ran) to the shared `result` / `checks[].status` vocabulary; `unbound` is a configuration defect and is never a `skipped` exemption.

narrowing.notice: platform.gate-result major 0 is declared for removal. It is still served: supported_major_versions remains [0, 1] and a 0.x document is still accepted. A consumer MUST emit 1.0.0 or later and MUST NOT depend on a value outside the 1.x vocabulary. Major 0 is removed only in a separate change that moves this record to state 'enforced' once the sole producer, driftwatchdog, emits platform.gate-result/1.0.0.

platform.release-evidence.description: Evidence envelope that ties a release to its artifacts, gates, and metadata.

platform.capability.description: Self-declared capability of a service: which contracts it can produce or consume, and at what stability level.
